## Give them a try if you have patience.
I tried to renew my service after using for one year. It took 48 hours for them to reactivate after contacting them on Whats app and via email. I am very disappointed in there customer service. As far as the video goes there were occasions over the past year that channels did not load and service would not be available for four to six hours. In December of 2025 I had to load a new IPTV player because there service no longer worked with it.   
When the service is working the video was very high quality. The selection of VOD is outstanding.  
I would give them 5 stars if they there service stood up to what they say it will be on there web site.
